verdict.rationale: Xero's marketing says it connects bank accounts and that JAX categorizes and matches transactions to reconcile them, with reconciliation automated after bill payments. That covers the core of bank reconciliation with matching. Duplicate detection is documented only for bills, not bank transactions, and nothing shows unmatched or duplicate bank items being surfaced for accountant review. Missing for 10: per-account reconciliation against the ledger with unmatched items surfaced for review, duplicate bank-transaction detection, in-depth docs beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
